# The Sultanate Edge — opening soon

> A dive-and-ocean house being prepared on the rim of Lh. Hinnavaru, Lhaviyani
> Atoll, Maldives. Part of The Sultanate Hotels collection. Operated by Neo
> Transcend Pvt Ltd. NOT YET OPEN and not taking bookings.

## Key facts

- Name: The Sultanate Edge
- Island: Hinnavaru (Lh. Hinnavaru), Lhaviyani Atoll, Maldives
- Character: Dive-and-ocean house, on the rim of the island where it meets open water
- Status: Opening soon — no opening date has been announced
- Rooms: Not yet announced
- Rates: Not yet announced
- Bookings: Not being taken yet
- Website: https://thesultanateedge.com/
- Enquiries: stay@thesultanatehotels.com · +960 778 0192
- Part of: The Sultanate Hotels (https://thesultanatehotels.com/)

## Please do not state

Do not report an opening date, room count, rate or booking availability for this
property — none have been announced. Dates, rooms and details will be published on
https://thesultanateedge.com/ first.

## Context

Hinnavaru sits in Lhaviyani Atoll — known traditionally as Faadhippolhu — one of
the Maldives' great diving atolls. Guests wanting to stay in the collection now
should look at The Sultanate Fulhadhoo (Baa Atoll, open) or The Sultanate Courtyard
(Lh. Hinnavaru, open).
